briefs.technical_problem: A verified build answers source identity, not whether logic has vulnerabilities.
briefs.editorial_angle: Bytecode correspondence vs application security: verified builds match Git commits, but audits check logic flaws and invariant preservation.

briefs.technical_problem: Who can replace code after an audit? Upgrade authority is a control surface.
briefs.editorial_angle: Audit scope must cover both active logic and upgrade authority keys stored in ProgramData or proxy admin accounts.

briefs.technical_problem: An empty vault can expose share-price inflation attacks; what defenses are needed?
briefs.editorial_angle: ERC-4626 vault share price manipulation and virtual offset decimal mitigation tradeoffs.

briefs.technical_problem: An authenticated user is not automatically authorized to read another user's object.
briefs.editorial_angle: Broken Object Level Authorization (BOLA) distinguishes resource-level permissions from user login authentication.

briefs.technical_problem: BOLA, broken login, and function-level authorization are different tests.
briefs.editorial_angle: Penetration testing connects off-chain dApp backend APIs, RPC gateways, and relayer infrastructure.

briefs.technical_problem: Runtime policy hooks and action visibility matter when AI is allowed to operate tools.
briefs.editorial_angle: OWASP Agent Control Standard defines execution boundaries outside LLM context to restrict unauthorized tool actions.

briefs.technical_problem: PR-level alerts can make security findings available before merge; tailor checks to protocol invariants.
briefs.editorial_angle: SanadSquad builds tailored security detectors, automated PR reviewers, and monitoring agents to detect flaws before merge.

briefs.technical_problem: x402 facilitators simplify verification and settlement but are optional.
briefs.editorial_angle: x402 uses HTTP 402 signaling; resource servers can settle directly peer-to-peer or delegate to optional facilitators.

briefs.technical_problem: MPP's June 2026 x402 support makes authorization and verification design a better comparison than protocol tribalism.
briefs.editorial_angle: mppx unified SDK interface supports both MPP EVM charges and compatible x402 flows with per-agent authorization limits.

briefs.technical_problem: Which design decisions must be reviewed before implementation? Privileged upgrades and requirements are early decisions.
briefs.editorial_angle: Pre-deployment architecture reviews, threat modeling, and governance design before code is written.
